title: How to register your parents on VerifyU
excerpt: A short, practical walkthrough for setting up a VerifyU profile for an older parent — photo, contacts and the medical basics — in one sitting.
author: VerifyU team
body:
This is a **draft** article created by the admin panel so you can see how publishing works. Edit it, or delete it, before you publish.

## Before you start

Keep three things within reach: the phone with the mobile number you will register, a clear photo of your parent's face, and the names and numbers of the two people you would want called.

## The steps

1. Download VerifyU and verify the mobile number with the OTP.
2. Add the personal details and a well-lit, straight-on photo.
3. Add two emergency contacts and the medical basics — blood group first.
4. Complete face verification in good light.

> Tell the two contacts that they are listed. On the day it matters, the call should not be a surprise.

Registration is free. Premium is optional and can be decided later.
